ctx.x: Oh Diddy Ramble. Oh diddy Ramble. Oh diddy Ramble around the town. To the little butchie cut him down.

Oh diddy Ramble. Well you guys would be coming along, diddy Ramble, and they're wibble and they're wibble and bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo bamboo You see what I'm talking about? That's called the second line. The second line was outnumbered the procession of the other wives. See what I'm talking about? And so I started doing that and I always did, humming around, I guess my mother could see it. And so I owe a lot to my mother. I stuck with it until she died…
